title: Trump says "I love the inflation" because U.S. is "taking" Iranian oil
summary: President says he loves the inflation because it is a by-product of a war that is seizing Iranian oil, with oil far below worst-case forecasts and the economy at its best ever.

assertions.quote: I love the inflation. You know why? Because as soon as this war is over, you know, I can say it now.

verdicts.note: The energy component should reverse when supply normalizes, but core inflation near three percent and tariff pass-through are not war-related and will not vanish with a ceasefire.

assertions.quote: we blasted the crap out of it. We took out That's why oil is $85 a barrel.

verdicts.note: No independent accounting of seized or released volumes exists; oil near eighty-five dollars mostly reflects spare OPEC capacity and demand rather than seizures.

assertions.quote: And the other thing is that oil would go to $250 a barrel. It's at 85. And which is pretty amazing.

verdicts.note: Some analysts warned a Hormuz closure could push crude past one hundred fifty dollars; prices in the eighties to low hundreds were well short of that.

assertions.quote: the one bad thing will be we hit the best economy we've ever hit
